## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** (user-facing changes)
- [ ] Docs updated (if behaviour or configuration changed)
- [ ] New UI text exists in both `de.ts` and `en.ts`
- [ ] Database changes come with a migration (`npm run db:generate`)
